categories.rationale: Fixes JSON-RPC 2.0 protocol compliance for malformed requests and eliminates an Assume() crash in debug builds. On master, unparseable requests lacking an id in batches were mistakenly suppressed as notifications, release builds returned non-compliant HTTP 400 responses instead of HTTP 200 error payloads, and debug builds aborted via an assertion failure.
